label: Martin of Tours (S. MARTINI, EPISCOPI, Die 11 novembris)

chants.notes: Engraving begins at the foot of p621 (mode label V, drop-cap A, 'Al-le-lu-ia') and its verse 'Beatus vir sanctus Martinus, urbis Turonis, requievit: quem susceperunt angeli atque archangeli, throni, dominationes et virtutes' continues on the page AFTER, at the top of p622. The band here crops only the p621 portion; gr_index_entry keys this alleluia to page 621 (row 1292, mode 5).
GR p622 prints 'Ps. 19*, 2. 3. 4. 5. 6. 7. 8. 9' immediately below this citation — a psalm-tone plan, not modeled.
